title: First Delhi campaign reaches Bengal
detail: Firuz Shah Tughlaq launched a major campaign into Bengal; Ilyas Shah avoided open battle and took shelter at Ekdala, where Delhi failed to secure a decisive conquest.

title: Second campaign fails to impose lasting Delhi control
detail: After Ilyas Shah's death, Delhi mounted another expedition during Sikandar Shah's reign, but Bengal's sultanate polity remained intact after the fighting and negotiation cycle.
